...CONTEMNORS  Petition under Sections 10 to 12 of Contempt of Courts Act 1971 praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit file herein the High Court may be pleased to pleased to punish the respondents under section 10 to 12 of contempt of courts Act, 1971 for wilfully, deliberately violating the orders passed by this Hon'ble court in Writ Petition number 30776 of 2018 dated 23-02-2022 and pass IA NO: 1 OF 2023 Petition under Section 151 CPC praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to grant leave to me to file contempt case No of 2023 as petitioner No.8 and pass Counsel for the Petitioner(s):SRI. S LAKSHMINARAYANA REDDY
Counsel for the Respondents: S SIVA KUMARI

The Court made the following:
This Court, by an order dated 23.02.2022, in W.P.No.30776 of 2018 had directed payment of damages to the petitioners @ 15% on the compensation awarded for the period from 02.06.1989 till 04.07.2016.

As the said amounts were not being paid, the petitioners had moved C.C.No.3193 of 2022 which came to be disposed of on 04.11.2022 with a direction to the respondents to comply with the order mentioned above within three months, failing which, the petitioners would be entitled to move this Court again under its contempt jurisdiction.
The petitioners again moved the present contempt case on the ground that no payments have been made till the date of filing of the contempt case.
Time has been taken on 08.01.2024 and 12.01.2024 for respondent No.1 to submit the time line within which the order of the Court would be complied with.
W.A.No.679 of 2023 filed against the above order of this Court came to be dismissed on 01.08.2023.
When the matter came up today, the learned counsel for respondent No.1 sought further time for giving the time line within which the order of the Court will be complied.

In view of the fact that no specific information is forthcoming from the 1st respondent, it would be appropriate to direct that this matter be taken up again on 15.03.2024 by which time the 1st respondent shall either comply with the directions of the Court or specify the time within which necessary payments will be made,
failing which, the 1st respondent shall be personally present in this Court on the next Dasari Venkatanna vs Sashi Bhushan Kumar on 13 February, 2024
